Ask the organism

A conversation with the organism in the cloud. Every prompt is posted to it (/api/ask) and its answer prints with its route; no model, no token, and nothing to install: any phone gets all of it. A follow-up ("and germany?", "plus 9") is read against the turns before it and printed as "read as". A prompt the cloud cannot answer yet is taken as a task: it says so, and its next era grows cells for it. Only when the cloud cannot be reached does this device answer, from what it already holds, and the answer says so.
the organism, live
how every answer prints its routeEvery answer prints how it was reached: route (which path answered), provenance (native: the conversation region; exact: computed with BigInt rationals, never rounded; grown: a cell the organism grew; memory; model), model (none: no language model was called), the lookup an answer was composed from, the microseconds the cloud took and the round trip this page measured. When the cloud is not reached, this device runs the same files node bin/brain.mjs ask runs, copied byte for byte, and prints the nanoseconds per ask measured on it:
act/exact-read.mjs 8376ffba0835 tasks/exact.mjs ede0ce88f1ad act/word.mjs c2dd2fe71b77 act/converse.mjs 4389c43af457 act/thread.mjs 431a1f246114 act/cells-tab.mjs 677518a29deb
this device grows nothing: the cloud does the work. The switch lets it grow cells too (never on a metered connection, with save-data on or on a low battery).
ready. every prompt goes to the organism in the cloud and comes back with its route; this device answers only when the cloud cannot be reached. Enter sends, Shift+Enter is a new line; a follow-up is read against the turns before it.
